title: Trivial internal actions, action restriction, and underlying exactness data
statement: Fix compatible universes [def-weil-size-convention] and a small site $(C,J)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Use the sectionwise linear action categories and forgetful functors of [def-sfb-internal-equivariant-module-sheaves]. For group presheaves $K,L$ and a natural group homomorphism $\theta:L\to K$, restrict a linear $K$-action on a module presheaf by $l\cdot m=\theta(l)\cdot m$. For a sheaf of rings $S$, define inflation $\mathcal E_K(S)\to\mathcal E_L(S)$ by this action, retaining the underlying module sheaf and every map. Define trivial action $\operatorname{Mod}(S)\to\mathcal E_K(S)$ by letting every group section act as the identity, again retaining every module and map [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Define ActionForgetExact to be the conjunction that the underlying module-sheaf functor is additive, preserves finite limits and finite colimits, detects exactness of short complexes and zero objects, creates each kernel and cokernel, preserves each kernel under section evaluation, and identifies its module-sheaf cokernel with module sheafification of the underlying presheaf cokernel [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. These are definitions and a proposition specifying exactness, not an assertion that the proposition holds. No nontriviality, injectivity, surjectivity or nonzero-ring assumption is imposed.
